_doc: PINNED RETRACTION -- consolidated cells for quarters where the company filed NO consolidated result at all. Distinct from copied_con_purge.json, which nulls con cells that EXACTLY EQUAL their standalone twin (the byte-copy signature, runbook 85a-ter). These cells DIFFER from standalone and therefore survived that purge -- but 'differs' only proves 'not a byte copy', it never proves 'a consolidated table exists'. Where the exchange record shows no consolidated filing, ANY con value is fabricated regardless of whether it differs. Entries carry held=<reason>, so verify_fills_live.py's resurrection check (runbook 85b) asserts these cells stay ABSENT and reports them if an applier refills them. Apply with scripts/apply_con_nofile_retractions.py (idempotent, re-runnable).

HUHTAMAKI.exchange_record: BSE announcement history scrip 509820, 2013-2026: 'Standalone & Consolidated Financial Results' headlines for QE 2016-03/06/09/12 and NO consolidated headline after 2017-02-21. Dec-2015 headline reads Standalone only.
HUHTAMAKI.company_submissions: 28 cached NSE XBRL instances covering QE 2020-06-30..2026-06-30 (symbols PAPERPROD then HUHTAMAKI) -- every one declares NatureOfReportStandaloneConsolidated=Standalone; ZERO Consolidated. Each instance's RevenueFromOperations reproduces our stored revS to the paisa in 23 of 23 quarters.
HUHTAMAKI.defect_mechanism: the stored revC is the STANDALONE statement's revenue sub-line 'a) Sale of Products & Services', not consolidated revenue. Proven to the paisa from the company's own PDFs: Dec-2022 filing (BSE d2280993-bc1c-4ebe-b329-2e2a38284c78.pdf) prints Sale of Products & Services 6,765.2 / 7,534.6 / 6,484.6 Mn for QE Dec-22 / Sep-22 / Dec-21 = our stored revC 676.52 / 753.46 / 648.46, while Total Revenue from Operations 6,927.1 / 7,690.3 / 6,615.7 Mn = our stored revS 692.71 / 769.03 / 661.57. 676.52 + 16.19 (Other Operating Revenue) = 692.71 exactly.
HUHTAMAKI.provenance: values entered scripts/revop_fundamentals.json at commit 4d63e91d8a (2026-07-22, 'Complete revenue backfill: ever-member Nifty 500 sweep'); the 20241231 duplicate arrived later, present by a94fd2ef8 (2026-08-04). No fill ledger in scripts/ claims these keys in any of the four key shapes -- revop_fundamentals.json held them with no per-cell provenance.
HUHTAMAKI.note: fiscal year is January-December; scale flips from 'Rs. in lacs' to 'Rs. in Million' at the Sep-2020 filing.

CAMPUS.company_submissions: cached NSE XBRL: QE 2022-03-31 and QE 2022-06-30 each filed BOTH a Standalone and a Consolidated instance (con RevenueFromOperations 3,523,370,000 and 3,377,080,000 = our genuine revC 352.34 and 337.71). QE 2022-09-30 (INDAS_861046_6647_11112022173840) is Standalone ONLY, as is every quarter through 2026-03-31. Sole subsidiary Campus AI Pvt Ltd was merged into the company by NCLT order dated 2022-08-11, so no consolidated result was required from QE 2022-09-30 onward.
